description: Returns a dashboard link where the developer deletes their OWN Neblla account; this tool deletes nothing. Once confirmed there, the account and all its apps wait 30 days in a bin (logging in cancels it; no tool works meanwhile), then they are deleted for good as neblla_delete_app does. End users: neblla_erase_user or neblla_set_ban_status. More: neblla_get_llms tools/delete_account
name: neblla_delete_account
title: Delete my account
